requirements.quote: immutable factory
requirements.checkable: Factory behavior and configuration are immutable.

requirements.quote: ERC-1167 clones
requirements.checkable: Raffles use the ERC-1167 clone architecture.

requirements.quote: immutable implementation
requirements.checkable: The implementation associated with deployed clones cannot be changed.

requirements.quote: One entry costs 1,000,000 units of canonical six-decimal USDC.
requirements.checkable: Each entry costs exactly 1,000,000 base units.

requirements.quote: canonical six-decimal USDC
requirements.checkable: The payment token is canonical USDC with six decimals; the deployment network is not identified in this document.

requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.
requirements.checkable: Each purchase mints one ERC721 ticket.

requirements.quote: transferable ERC721 ticket
requirements.checkable: Tickets support transfer of ownership.

requirements.quote: representing a contiguous inclusive range
requirements.checkable: Each ticket represents a contiguous entry range with both endpoints included.

requirements.quote: Exactly one ERC721 prize is escrowed atomically at creation.
requirements.checkable: Each raffle escrows exactly one ERC721 prize.

requirements.quote: Exactly one ERC721 prize is escrowed atomically at creation.
requirements.checkable: Creation and custody of the prize succeed or revert atomically.

requirements.quote: Reserve met awards NFT
requirements.checkable: The reserve-met outcome awards the NFT prize.

requirements.quote: Reserve met awards NFT and 95% sponsor / 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: In the reserve-met outcome the sponsor allocation is 95%; the denominator is implicit in this clause and should be checked against gross proceeds.

requirements.quote: Reserve met awards NFT and 95% sponsor / 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: In the reserve-met outcome the treasury allocation is 5%; the denominator is implicit in this clause and should be checked against gross proceeds.

requirements.quote: Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: In the reserve-missed outcome the winner receives 80% of gross proceeds.

requirements.quote: Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: In the reserve-missed outcome the sponsor receives 15% of gross proceeds.

requirements.quote: Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury.
requirements.checkable: In the reserve-missed outcome the treasury receives 5% of gross proceeds.

requirements.quote: Refund outcome pays 100% per entry
requirements.checkable: The refund outcome returns the full entry price for each entry.

requirements.quote: Refund outcome pays 100% per entry and returns prize.
requirements.checkable: The refund outcome returns the prize; the recipient is not explicitly named in this clause.

requirements.quote: Rounding is floor on aggregate protocol fee
requirements.checkable: The aggregate protocol fee is rounded down.

requirements.quote: remainder must be allocated without loss.
requirements.checkable: All residual amounts from rounding remain allocated and are not lost.

requirements.quote: No administrator, mutable configuration or upgrade.
requirements.checkable: The protocol has no administrator.

requirements.quote: No administrator, mutable configuration or upgrade.
requirements.checkable: Deployed protocol configuration cannot be changed.

requirements.quote: No administrator, mutable configuration or upgrade.
requirements.checkable: The protocol cannot be upgraded.

requirements.quote: Request window [sale end, end+2days)
requirements.checkable: Draw requests are accepted at sale end and rejected before sale end.

requirements.quote: Request window [sale end, end+2days)
requirements.checkable: Draw requests are rejected at or after two days following sale end.

requirements.quote: callback accepted strictly before request timestamp+2days.
requirements.checkable: Randomness callbacks are accepted only before the request timestamp plus two days.

requirements.quote: Refunds open at deadline.
requirements.checkable: Refunds become available at the applicable deadline; this clause does not explicitly distinguish request expiry from callback expiry.

requirements.quote: Callback records result only.
requirements.checkable: The callback records the result without settling or transferring assets.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless
requirements.checkable: Any caller may perform settlement when settlement prerequisites hold.

requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only
requirements.checkable: Settlement changes storage without asset transfers or other external execution; storage-only is not further defined.

requirements.quote: redemption requires current ticket owner
requirements.checkable: Redemption authority is checked against the current ticket owner.

requirements.quote: burns claim atomically
requirements.checkable: Redemption consumes the claim atomically with redemption.

requirements.quote: must revert all effects on delivery failure.
requirements.checkable: If delivery fails all effects of redemption revert.

requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.
requirements.checkable: The sponsor can claim its allocation after settlement.

requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.
requirements.checkable: The treasury can claim its allocation after settlement.

requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.
requirements.checkable: The sponsor claim does not depend on the treasury claim succeeding.

requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.
requirements.checkable: The treasury claim does not depend on the sponsor claim succeeding.

requirements.quote: Never move assets between raffle clones.
requirements.checkable: No execution path transfers assets from one raffle clone to another.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies
requirements.checkable: The quote token is a trusted canonical dependency; correctness of that external token is assumed.

requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies
requirements.checkable: The Chainlink wrapper is a trusted canonical dependency; correctness of that external wrapper is assumed.

requirements.quote: arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: Prize contracts are arbitrary untrusted external contracts.

requirements.quote: arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.
requirements.checkable: Ticket recipients are untrusted external actors or contracts.

requirements.quote: Frontend discovery is advisory
requirements.checkable: Frontend discovery results alone are not authoritative for transaction decisions.

requirements.quote: transaction decisions must reread current chain state.
requirements.checkable: Transaction decisions refresh relevant state from the chain before acting.
